Audit fixes (behaviour): - loopback RCON is off by default: TURN with its public credentials could relay anyone to 127.0.0.1; - a password or Connect anyway is for the launch right after it - one stopped early (waiting for the sign-in, Cancel) drops them, so they never reach another server; - netcode: a handshake that would push a live cookie out of the used ring is refused (no replayed response); - a WebRTC failure before its DataChannel says so, with Retry, instead of "Connecting..." for good; - the server's key is kept once proven (a kick for a wrong password destroyed the client that knew it); - the masterserver's dump of the list reads again (a field gone from it was still read) and browser servers come back through the signalling; - bans of servers in one process are merged into their file, not overwritten (a damaged file kept as .damaged); - a report refused with 401 is retried (the site may not know a new key yet); - RCON gets the settings back even when nothing changed (no "Applying changes..." for good); - an additional server list at the main one's address is not sent to twice (heartbeats went round); - /cert requests never follow a redirect; the CrazyGames token is not logged; a web download with progress has no 5 s limit; - a sync list download keeps the list when it fails; the link page is good for 15 minutes; Cancel while it is open asks quietly later; - the abandon warning says what happens (a lost match); a comma for a semicolon.
